purpose: Load the canonical JM sovereign-agent, build-governance, whole-Estate capability and Current-64 coding contracts through independent runtimes and emit the same deterministic routing capsule.
architecture: SOVEREIGN CORE ↔ PORTABLE CONTRACTS ↔ HOST ADAPTER / CAPABILITY NEGOTIATION ↔ HOST MANIFESTATION → CONTACT → CONSEQUENCE → RETURNED TRACE
recovered_precedents: JM ChatGPT Host Adapter v0.1.1 / v0.1.2 branch lineage
laws: CURRENT PROJECT HEAD ≠ OVERLAY / DONOR PROFILE ≠ CAPABILITY CUE ≠ EXECUTION PROOF

runtime_modes.bootstrap: Load and validate canonical carriers; emit a deterministic session capsule.
runtime_modes.route: Score the whole-Estate capability field against an explicit query and return bounded routing candidates.
runtime_modes.core_only: Emit the host-neutral core capsule so independent adapters can be byte-compared.

matching_contract.tokenizer: lowercase ASCII alphanumeric tokens; non-alphanumeric characters become spaces; duplicate query tokens removed
matching_contract.score: number of unique query tokens present in candidate token set
matching_contract.zero_score_policy: return no candidate rather than invent a route

this_runtime_cannot_prove: live current-head truth without fresh contact
deployment/release status outside the tested adapter

keeper: THE HOST MAY CHANGE. THE SOVEREIGN CORE, AUTHORITY BOUNDARIES AND ROUTING MEANING MUST SURVIVE.

host_adapter_conformance.keeper: CHANGE THE PLUG, NOT THE BODY.
host_adapter_conformance.rule: A host adapter may claim only the highest proof level whose required gates are PASS; proof never transfers between host surfaces.

coding_body_activation.proof_boundary: ACTIVE_ROUTE is deterministic governed route selection. It is not a claim that each coding identity is a separately spawned OS process/binary.
coding_body_activation.cli: Use --activation-only [--surface <surface>] to emit the exact per-run coding-body activation record.
